test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'RAJAT' is coded as UCMCW and 'NIRAJ' is coded as QKUCM. How will 'MUKUL' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘RAJAT' is coded as 'UCMCW’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb1bf3226177c75b425e57c7a5dd44be508a7fe1ca24bd717468f7fa751e599d.png] 

NIRAJ' is coded as 'QKUCM',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1871ddb1f9cacd979ae72e7d9b93d69087049c62238905a1a8ad67113f6a615.png] 

Similarly, for '**MUKUL**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd385bad16d699e84f10cad9eb4d50aed74d65d9006eb06c17f6cb9cee5430c0.png] 

So, '**PREFER**' will be coded as '**PWNWO**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
